info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cash Management Update API
info.description: The Cash Management Update API facilitates the modification of cash management configurations within trade banking. Businesses can utilize this API to adjust key parameters related to their cash resources, ensuring optimized financial management. Typical consumers include financial institutions and corporate treasury departments looking to enhance their cash management processes. This operation can significantly streamline cash flow monitoring and control, enabling more precise financial decision-making.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific cash management account identified by its account number. Ensure all required fields are accurately filled to prevent errors during the update process.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the cash management account identified by ACC-200045. Ensure that all required fields are included and correctly formatted to successfully process the update.
